datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Malawi administrative areas. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity, with multiple scenarios projected for medium-term forecasting in 2015.
